answer: Because the timing is recorded against the sonnet challenge, the tundra audit can replay the sable history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm hence has to pad 82 submissions and hold every identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 2248 identities would post 2583 proofs and burn roughly 35 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
